_comment: Speaker notes + per-slide titles for OWASP Porto #13 – EBG13 (18 slides). Loaded by js/notes-loader.js. Sections: Welcome(0-1) · OWASP(2-3) · Porto Chapter(4-8) · Next(9-10) · News(11) · Today's Event(12-14) · Close(15-17).

slides.title: Cover
slides.notes: Hold on the cover while people settle: OWASP Porto #13, EBG13, November 24th, 18:00, at the OERN temporary headquarters (Rua Dr. Alfredo Magalhães 8, 2nd floor). Venue, snacks and drinks by OERN.

slides.title: Welcome
slides.notes: Welcome everyone to the OWASP Porto Chapter meetup, #13, EBG13.

slides.title: About OWASP
slides.notes: One line on what OWASP is: a nonprofit improving software security through open-source projects, conferences and local chapters.

slides.title: Become a Member
slides.notes: Encourage membership; mention the corporate-supporter ask for companies in the room.

slides.title: Mission
slides.notes: Porto Chapter: why we exist and what we do. Keep it brief.

slides.title: Who Are We
slides.notes: Introduce the chapter leads and volunteers; invite the audience to get involved.

slides.title: Resources
slides.notes: Where to find us: site, email, LinkedIn, Luma (subscribe!), Slack and Instagram (both new), X. Meetup.com is retired; Luma is the place to subscribe.

slides.title: Event Archive
slides.notes: 12 events held in Porto so far, from 2024 to July 2026. Point to the event-archive site for talks, speakers and photos.

slides.title: Call for Talks
slides.notes: We are always looking for speakers. Scan the QR or use the link.

slides.title: Name Riddle
slides.notes: Recap the previous one: #12 Cerberus, because capturing Cerberus was the twelfth labour of Hercules (painting: Zurbaran, Hercules and Cerberus, 1634, Prado). This time the cognome is EBG13. Leave the audience guessing; the feedback form asks for their theories. Do not reveal it tonight before the end.

slides.title: Next Meetup
slides.notes: Next meetup: tentatively January 13th, 2027, at INESC TEC. Date not final yet; watch Luma. Still welcome hosts and sponsors for future events.

slides.title: AppSec Days
slides.notes: AppSec Days Portugal 2026, Porto, Sep 23-24, in the numbers shown at the closing session: 430 registered attendees (56 from abroad, 19 countries), 56 CFP proposals, 15 talks in 2 tracks, 15 speakers incl. 2 keynotes (Lukas Weichselbaum, Petra Vukmirovic), 4 half-day workshops, CTF by xSTF.pt. Ask who was there and what they enjoyed; point them to the feedback form section about the conference.

slides.title: Today's Event
slides.notes: Divider. Hand over to today's programme.

slides.title: Supported By
slides.notes: Thank the Ordem dos Engenheiros Região Norte for hosting us at their temporary headquarters and for the snacks and drinks. Second time at OERN, after #06 The Farmer in 2025.

slides.title: Agenda
slides.notes: 18:00 welcome · 18:15 Teresa Limpo (Performance Under Fire: decision-making under pressure) · 19:00 Milton Araújo (PHP2Shell, CVE-2026-109618, live demo) · 20:00 snacks and drinks.

slides.title: Thanks
slides.notes: Thank attendees; we hope they enjoy the event.

slides.title: Feedback
slides.notes: Ask everyone to fill the feedback form: scan the QR (https://forms.gle/vk1XH3rqRfCYugEX9). It also asks whether they went to AppSec Days and what they thought.

slides.title: Thank You
slides.notes: Close. Thank the speakers and OERN once more.
